mainEntity.name: What do I need before I can get a shower installation quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most shower installation projects can move forward once the contractor has space measurements, photos of the existing bathroom, and a clear idea of the finish you want. If the job involves plumbing relocation, tile, or custom glass, expect a more detailed site visit before pricing is accurate.
